description: Strategic mobility optionality for a jurisdiction: the lawful residence/citizenship ROUTES it offers (investment programmes) with minimum physical presence, family inclusion, path to permanence, processing time and regulator — the planning view of mobility, not passport strength. Passport reach (visa-free count) is included as context only. Pass cc for one jurisdiction, omit for all. INFORMATION, NOT ADVICE; combine with the full immigration profile and a Mirabello consultation.
